text:
maria: Quick sync — we need a minimal preflight for the Cloud Marketplace listing across AWS/GCP/Azure. Items I think we must lock down: legal package, branding assets, trial SKU mapping, telemetry/usage hooks, and credentials for publisher portal. Who can take point on each?

alex: I can own product packaging/trial SKU mapping. will do an inventory of current trial configs and what needs to be exposed.

jon: I’ll handle the legal artifacts + contract checklist. note: publisher agreements differ across clouds, expect a couple of CLA and tax docs. I’ll list exact doc names by EOD.

maria: thanks. alex — can you also confirm whether trial is time-limited or seat-limited per cloud? some marketplaces force time windows.

alex: good call — AWS supports metered trials + time-limited trials; GCP tends to prefer credit-based trials; Azure has reseller constraints. i’ll map to our SKU model.

maria: tasha — can you confirm publisher portal creds + who from infra needs access? we’ll need a service account for automated packaging.

tasha: on it. i’ll provision a publisher SA for each cloud and hand over keys via our secrets vault. will also add a short runbook for rotation.

maria: sweet. also we need telemetry hooks: product/usage events to attribute installs/trials back to partner campaigns. sreekar, can you own instrumentation?

sreekar: yep. i’ll add a tiny endpoint that the marketplace package will ping with install+trial-start events. output will be a compact JSON: {"tenant_id":..., "offer_id":..., "event":"trial_start"}. will post schema here.

jon: legal note — telemetry has PII constraints. schema needs to avoid user_email and any customer PII. use hashed IDs where needed. also include data residency flags per region.

sreekar: got it. will strip emails and only send hashed tenant_id + region tag.

alex: product question — do we want a special promotional SKU for marketplace-only trials (so we can track promo conversions)?

maria: yes, promo SKU preferred. alex, include that in your inventory. we’ll need mapping in billing.

jon: also need to confirm indemnity and export control clauses for each cloud listing. i’ll flag any nonstandard items.

maria: timeline proposal: have ownerships confirmed today, assets & legal checklist by Thu, publisher creds + telemetry by Fri, and attempt initial staging push next Monday. realistic?

alex: timeline ✅ for SKU + packaging by Thu.

jon: legal checklist by Thu afternoon.

maria: tasha: creds + runbook by Fri?

tasha: yes. I’ll create the SA in each cloud and drop vault links.

sreekar: telemetry endpoint + schema by Fri morning.

maria: perfect. action items recap:
- alex: inventory of SKUs, define promo SKU + trial type mapping (AWS/GCP/Azure) — due Thu.
- jon: full legal artifact checklist + contract caveats per cloud — due Thu.
- tasha: publisher SA creation + secrets in vault + rotation runbook — due Fri.
- sreekar: telemetry schema + small ingest endpoint + sample payloads (no PII) — due Fri.

maria: one more thing — branding: we need hero image, 2 screenshots, short description, and marketing contact for approvals. who has the assets?

alex: design team handed over a hero and three screenshots last sprint. i’ll grab the approved ones and resize per store guidelines.

maria: awesome. please put final images in the partner-assets folder and post links here.

deploy-bot: NOTE: packaging bot will run initial validation once publisher creds exist. will post results to #partnerships when triggered.

jon: heads-up — I may request localized EULA snippets for EU regions; could delay GCP slightly if needed.

maria: call it out in the checklist. if localization needed, we won’t block AWS/Azure staging.

alex: quick question on telemetry: do we need to support both webhook push and pull-based usage exports (some clouds only give billing exports)?

sreekar: implement webhook push for install/trial events. for usage/billing, we’ll ingest cloud CSV exports later. file-based ingestion is a separate task.

maria: ok. i’ll update the master onboarding doc with owners and deadlines. i’ll ping again with the doc link.

alex: FYI — I found a small mismatch in our SKU naming vs marketplace constraints: no underscores, max 64 chars. will normalize and include mapping table.

maria: thanks. small admin: include the publisher account email prefix in the runbook so ops knows which portal to log into.

tasha: will add.

maria: closing note — anyone need extra support from GTM/legal/engineering? if so drop a brief note. otherwise we’ll proceed with the timeline. :thumbsup:

jon: might need a quick consult with tax ops for VAT specifics, will loop them in.

sreekar: i might need 1 engineer-hour from infra for secret mounting on the packaging runner. tagging infra.

maria: great. thanks team — will post the onboarding doc soon and tag folks.
